name: Placoplatre SA
summary: Placoplatre SA engages in the provision of insulation solutions under the Placo brand in France. It offers plate, honeycomb partition, plaster tile, decorative ceilings, profiles, accessories, plaster, joint compounds, surface preparation coatings, mortar, adhesives, and interior wall insulation products. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Courbevoie, France. Placoplatre SA operates as a subsidiary of Compagnie de Saint-Gobain S.A.
